overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a strong, focused professional presence across LinkedIn, Bluesky, and Mastodon with a combined audience of 3,580 followers. Content heavily emphasizes computational social science, coordinated inauthentic behavior, tool updates (CooRnet), and academic opportunities, generating high overall engagement particularly on specialized research announcements and career/study opportunities.

contentThemes.description: Announcements of new research papers, methodology discussions, and conference presentations on coordinated behavior and disinformation.
Product and version releases like CooRnet v2.0 for link-sharing analysis.
Recruitment posts for Postdoc and PhD positions and research grant announcements.

recommendations: Increase posting frequency on Mastodon and LinkedIn to leverage their established user base and drive higher absolute interaction volume.
Utilize rich media, infographic summaries, or direct links to full open-access papers when announcing new research or tool releases to boost reposts/shares.
Cross-promote interactive calls to action (e.g., student/postdoc applications) across all platforms simultaneously to maximize reach.

platformInsights.bluesky: Yields the highest average engagement rate (6.14%), with academic research announcements and student opportunities driving significant repost volume.
platformInsights.mastodon: Serves a dedicated niche audience interested in specific methodological tools like CooRnet and technical discussions around platform manipulation.
platformInsights.linkedin: Drives the largest raw interaction numbers (likes and professional comments), making it the most effective channel for major career milestones and hiring announcements.

topPerformingContent.content: Just published our new paper on coordinated inauthentic behavior on social media platforms!
New research opportunity for PhD students interested in computational social science. Reply for details!
Excited to announce that our research team has been awarded a new grant to study information operations across social media platforms.
